Control settings for zinbreg()

Source: R/control.R
zinbreg_control.Rd

Control settings for zinbreg()

Usage

zinbreg_control(
  tol = 1e-08,
  par_tol = 1e-06,
  maxit = 1000,
  mstep_tol = 1e-10,
  mstep_maxit = 100,
  theta_warn = 1e+05,
  trace = FALSE
)

Arguments

tol

EM tolerance (Sec 3.2). EM has converged when the observed-data log-likelihood changes by less than tol and no parameter (\(\beta\), \(\gamma\), \(\log\theta\)) changes by more than par_tol between EM iterations.

par_tol

Tolerance on the largest parameter change; see tol.

maxit

Maximum number of EM iterations.

mstep_tol, mstep_maxit

Tolerance and iteration limit for the M-step fits. Each M-step is a full fit, warm-started at the current values: the weighted NB fit uses nbreg_control() with tol = irls_tol = theta_tol = mstep_tol and these iteration limits, and the logistic IRLS uses the same tolerance and limit.

theta_warn

Warn if \(\hat\theta\) exceeds this value.

trace

Logical; if TRUE, print the log-likelihood at every EM iteration.

Value

A list of class "zinbreg_control".

Examples

zinbreg_control(tol = 1e-10, maxit = 2000)
#> $tol
#> [1] 1e-10
#> 
#> $par_tol
#> [1] 1e-06
#> 
#> $maxit
#> [1] 2000
#> 
#> $mstep_tol
#> [1] 1e-10
#> 
#> $mstep_maxit
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $theta_warn
#> [1] 1e+05
#> 
#> $trace
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "zinbreg_control"
